title: 72小时！：艾格与库什纳，闪电收购湖人，估值超百亿？
speaker: Randall Williams

segments.en: Sure. So as you said, Bob Eiger and Josh Kushner were looking at the NBA expansion team in Las Vegas.
segments.zh: 没错，正如你所说，鲍勃·艾格和乔什·库什纳原本在考虑拉斯维加斯的NBA扩军球队。

segments.en: And then the price was getting high as what Eiger told me. And at some point, a little birdie or an intermediary suggested or told Bob Eiger and Josh Kushner, hey, you should go look at the Lakers.
segments.zh: 艾格告诉我，当时价格越抬越高。后来有内部消息人士或中间人建议他们：不如去看看湖人队。

segments.en: And sure enough that had to be on Saturday or Sunday. And some 72 hours later, maybe 90 hours later, they had to deal.
segments.zh: 果然，那大概是在周六或周日。大约72小时，也许90小时后，他们就达成了交易。

segments.en: They were looking in Vegas. They were going to start a team from scratch, Randall. What happened? I really think that there's a Walmart family involved, or a Walton family involved.
segments.zh: 他们原本在拉斯维加斯，打算从零开始组建球队。兰德尔，发生了什么？我认为沃尔玛家族，也就是沃尔顿家族参与其中。

segments.en: And there's a couple of other groups involved in Las Vegas, including GoFoli, who's the owner of the Golden Knights. And then you have Mark Lazarie and the group known as the Las Vegas Jacks.
segments.zh: 拉斯维加斯还有其他几个集团参与，包括金骑士队老板戈福利，还有马克·拉扎里及其团队，即拉斯维加斯杰克队。

segments.en: When you have that many groups involved, naturally, that competition is going to drive the price high. Now, Josh Kushner and Bob Eiger were considered favorites.
segments.zh: 这么多集团参与，竞争自然会推高价格。乔什·库什纳和鲍勃·艾格原本是热门人选。

segments.en: However, if they say it's high, I can only imagine that I would guesstimate that it's over $10 billion.
segments.zh: 不过，如果他们都觉得价格太高，我只能猜测，成交价可能超过100亿美元。
